scenarios.name: first-entry
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: WS-COMM-AREA initialised, the map sent ERASE

scenarios.name: first-entry-uctran
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0 with the terminal translating to upper case (UCTRAN): the setting is stored and SET to NOUCTRAN

scenarios.name: first-entry-tranidonly
scenarios.why: the terminal's UCTRANST TRANIDONLY: also SET to NOUCTRAN

scenarios.name: pa1
scenarios.why: PA1: CONTINUE, nothing sent; RETURN TRANSID with the COMMAREA

scenarios.name: pf3
scenarios.why: PF3: RETURN TRANSID('OMEN') IMMEDIATE: back to the main menu

scenarios.name: pf12
scenarios.why: PF12: SEND-TERMINATION-MSG, RETURN

scenarios.name: clear
scenarios.why: CLEAR: SEND CONTROL ERASE FREEKB, RETURN

scenarios.name: other-key
scenarios.why: PF7: WHEN OTHER -- 'Invalid key pressed.', SEND MAP DATAONLY ALARM

scenarios.name: mapfail
scenarios.why: ENTER with no field modified: RECEIVE MAP MAPFAIL -- ABNDPROC LINKed (an ABNDFILE record) and ABEND HBNK

scenarios.name: born-before-1601
scenarios.why: every field valid, born 01/01/1500: LINK CRECUST, whose date-of-birth check refuses the date before CEEDAYS ('O'): 'Sorry, customer is too old'

scenarios.name: create-customer
scenarios.why: every field valid, born 12/07/1985: LINK CRECUST runs the credit check (five RUN children), DATE-OF-BIRTH-CHECK calls CEEDAYS (L1: the picture's 2 slack bytes ruled blank), then writes the CUSTOMER record and the PROCTRAN 'OCC' row

scenarios.name: born-in-the-future
scenarios.why: every field valid, born 01/01/2099: the same credit check, CEEDAYS (L1: the picture's 2 slack bytes ruled blank), then DATE-OF-BIRTH-CHECK refuses a date after today; no customer written

scenarios.name: yyyy-not-numeric

scenarios.name: link-crecust-pgmiderr

scenarios.name: born-30-feb
scenarios.why: born 30/02/1985: passes the day/month range checks but CRECUST's CEEDAYS refuses the date, fail code 'Z'

scenarios.name: pf12-send-text-tsioerr
scenarios.why: PF12: SEND-TERMINATION-MSG's SEND TEXT ERASE FREEKB (STM010) fails TSIOERR (planned, register X71): nothing is sent and the non-NORMAL arm takes the abend routine

scenarios.name: first-entry-plain-return-invreq
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: the closing RETURN TRANSID .. COMMAREA RESP (A010) fails INVREQ RESP2 4 (planned: IBM's TRANSID in a program associated with an APPC logical unit, register X71) -- the program goes on to its A010 abend routine

notes: CBSA's create-customer screen (BNK1CCS, transaction OCCS, BMS map BNK1CC of mapset BNK1CCM: the symbolic map is generated from src/base/bms_src/BNK1CCM.bms). Pseudo-conversational: Its terminal is a stated fact of the run: T001 (EIBTRMID), UCTRANST NOUCTRAN unless a scenario says UCTRAN or TRANIDONLY (INQUIRE / SET TERMINAL UCTRANST, oracle_assumptions.md X26), the stored setting in WS-COMM-TERM (451 in every returning scenario). A first task stores the terminal's UCTRAN setting (INQUIRE / SET TERMINAL UCTRANST) and sends the empty map; a returning one acts on the AID -- PA keys nothing, PF3 and PF12 restore the setting (PF3 RETURN TRANSID('OMEN') IMMEDIATE), CLEAR, ENTER (EDIT-DATA of title, names, address and date of birth, then LINK CRECUST with SUBPGM-PARMS), any other key 'Invalid key pressed.'. Every title spelling EDIT-DATA's EVALUATE lists is a scenario. CRECUST, its five credit-agency children and ABNDPROC run in the task, as in cbsa-crecust (header, data and notes: the async credit check is X18, ASSUMED). #4952, #5089 -- ASSUMED (register): create-customer (born 12/07/1985) and born-in-the-future (01/01/2099) reach CRECUST's CEEDAYS call, whose picture is declared 10 bytes over 8 (oracle_assumptions.md L1): the 2 slack bytes are ruled blank by the owner (2026-10-23, ASSUMED), so the call is modelled and a customer is created (CUSTOMER record, PROCTRAN 'OCC' row). born-before-1601 ends before CEEDAYS ('O'). Also open: X18 (the child credit schedule is ASSUMED); L4 is settled. Data: seed.sql and customer.txt are cbsa-crecust's, SYNTHETIC.
